title: Spanish Paella with Tomatoes
description: A classic Spanish dish made with saffron-infused rice, tender chicken, and fresh tomatoes. This paella recipe is perfect for a special occasion or a weekend dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from pan and set aside.
Add the paella seasoning and cook for 1 minute.
Add the rice and stir to coat with oil and seasoning. Cook for 2 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, saffron, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Add 4 cups of water to the pan and bring to a boil.
Add the cooked chicken back to the pan and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Remove from heat and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
